decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the single storey rear extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (PR-A0.01 Rev 01, PR-A1.01 Rev 01, PR-A1.02 Rev 01, PR-A2.01 Rev 01, PR-A2.02, PR-A3.01 Rev 01, LO-A-02 Rev 01, LO-A-01 Rev 01, Environment Agency Flood Risk Matrix, EX-A0.01 Rec 01, EX-A1.01 Rec 01, EX-A1.02 Rec 01, EX-A2.01 Rec 01, EX-A3.01 Rec 01, Design and Access Statement - Received 03/09/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as 19 Waldeck Road, and not as primary residential accommodation or for business purposes, nor shall any bathroom or kitchen facilities be installed into the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
description: Erection of a single storey rear and side extension, a rear roof extension and alterations to windows at front and rear of house. Erection of an outbuilding in rear garden.
